description: Search for PC games across Steam, GOG, Humble Bundle, IndieGala, Gamesplanet, Fanatical, and GameBillet to find exact titles, relevance scores, and store availability.

country.description: Two-letter country code for regional pricing (default: "CA"). Supported: CA, US, GB, AU, DE, FR.

query.description: Game title or keywords to search for (e.g. "Hades II", "Cyberpunk 2077"). Must be 2-150 characters.

name: search_games
